verdict.rationale: Linear's API supports OAuth2 and personal API keys (linear-docs-50), OAuth apps can be provisioned via manifest (linear-docs-42), and admins can gate third-party app installs and manage agent identity via Okta (linear-docs-73, linear-docs-67, linear-docs-60). However there is no explicit documentation of configurable scopes or least-privilege permission sets for agent credentials—only broad OAuth/API-key auth and admin approval gates. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity controls for API keys or OAuth tokens issued to agents, and independent confirmation that these controls actually restrict agent access.
